svg.title: Matched decision journey and proposed evaluation
svg.desc: Both architecture patterns follow corresponding discovery, authorization, verification, decision, action and update steps in a proposed synthetic experiment. The same discovery, request, authorization, verification, interpretation, decision, action and update responsibilities are assessed in both patterns. The fixture and its oracle are synthetic. This diagram and the test-case table define a proposed experiment; they do not report comparative execution results.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Matched decision journey and proposed evaluation

Both architecture patterns follow corresponding discovery, authorization, verification, decision, action and update steps in a proposed synthetic experiment. This diagram and the test-case table define a proposed experiment; they do not report comparative execution results.
